name: Chung Ye-jin
bio: Chung Ye-jin, previously known as Jung Woo-rim, is a South Korean actress under DSPmedia (디에스피미디어). She completed her studies at Dongduk Women's University's Department of Broadcasting and Entertainment. Ye-jin made a significant career shift in 2018 when she joined JiKim Entertainment (지킴 엔터테인먼트와) under her real name.
